shortDescription: Create network ports for a VM

options.name: cloud
options.description: A dictionary containing authentication and connection parameters for the destination OpenStack cloud. This should include details like C(auth_url), C(username), C(password), C(project_name), C(user_domain_name), C(project_domain_name), C(region_name), etc., or a C(cloud) key to use a clouds.yaml profile.

options.name: network_name
options.description: Name of the network to which the ports should be attached.

options.name: os_migrate_nics_file_path
options.description: Path of the nics file dumped by the VMware migration kit. It could be the json macs_{{vm_name}}.json file or the nics_{{vm_name}}.json file.

options.name: security_groups
options.description: List of security groups to be attached to the ports.

options.name: use_fixed_ips
options.description: Whether to assign fixed IPs to the created ports based on the IP addresses found in the nics file. Only IPv4 addresses are used and other IPv6 addresses from VMware metadata are ignored so Neutron fixed IPs can target a single IPv4 subnet without requiring matching IPv6 subnets.

options.name: used_mapped_networks
options.description: Whether the nics file contains mapped networks or not.

options.name: vm_name
options.description: Name of the VM for which the nics file was dumped.
